evidence: In-situ attenuated total internal reflection infrared spectroscopy has been used to examine initial adsorption and reaction steps in atomic layer deposition of HfO2 from tetrakis(diethylamino) hafnium (TDEAHf) on SiO2 and hydrogen-terminated Si(100) surfaces. ... The reaction sequence involved (i) preparing the ATR wafer surface by external wet chemical treatment and placing the surface in a vacuum system to pump to the 10-6-10-7 Torr range; (ii) comparing the IR signal from the clean surface to a reference wafer to confirm surface cleanliness; (iii) heating the sample and allowing 30 min for the temperature to equilibrate; and (iv) introducing precursor to the reaction chamber and monitoring pressure and IR signal as a function of time.
